newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Suncorp-Metway says has made good progress.
newsitem.headline: Suncorp-Metway says has made good progress.

text.p: Suncorp-Metway Ltd managing director Steve Jones said on Tuesday the bank and insurance group had made excellent progress since the merger between Metway Bank, Suncorp and QIDC on December 1, 1996.

"General insurance gross written premiums are up 11 percent on the same period last year, our home lending base is up 13 percent and we have kept our sales in life and superannuation," Jones said in a statement.
Jone said that while the Group's profit for the year ended 30 June would not be announced until September, profitability since the merger had been quite satisfactory.
"We set a goal of making $40 million in performance improvements on an annual basis by 30 June 1997 and we've met our goal," Jones said.
This was achieved by using the group's combined buying power to reduce what it pays for goods and services, improving the processing of insurance claims and through job reductions, Jones said.
At 3.20 p.m. (0520 GMT), Suncorp-Metway shares were one cent firmer at A$6.80.
